article.headline: Towson secures 82-50 victory over Hampton
article.description: — Dylan Williamson had 29 points in Towson's 82-50 win over Hampton on Saturday.
article.story: TOWSON, Md. -- — Dylan Williamson had 29 points in Towson's 82-50 win over Hampton on Saturday. Williamson added seven assists for the Tigers (13-11, 5-6 Coastal Athletic Association). Jack Doumbia scored 15 points while shooting 6 of 11 from the field and 3 for 6 from the line and added 10 rebounds. Mor Seck had 11 points and shot 5 of 5 from the field and 1 of 4 from the free-throw line. The Pirates (10-13, 4-6) were led by Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt, who recorded 11 points. Etienne Strothers added 10 points for Hampton. Xzavier Long had eight points, 11 rebounds and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
